# Databricks

> Databricks is the leading unified Data and AI platform enabling enterprises to build, deploy, and govern data intelligence and generative AI applications at scale.

Databricks provides a comprehensive lakehouse architecture that combines data lakes and warehouses with AI capabilities, governance tools, and ecosystem partnerships. The platform serves Fortune 500 enterprises, startups, and partners across AWS, Azure, and Google Cloud.

## Key Topics

- Lakehouse Architecture
- Delta Lake
- Unity Catalog
- Data Intelligence Platform
- Databricks SQL
- Generative AI
- GenAI Agents
- Data Governance
- ETL/Data Engineering
- Delta Sharing
- Mosaic AI
- DBRX Model
- Real-time Processing
- AI Research
- Cloud Partnerships

## Core Platform & Architecture

- [Databricks: Leading Data and AI Platform for Enterprises](https://www.databricks.com): Databricks unified data and AI platform with Lakebase, Agent Bricks, and lakehouse architecture
- [Data Lakehouse Architecture | Databricks](https://www.databricks.com/product/data-lakehouse): Lakehouse architecture combining data lakes and warehouses with Delta Lake and Apache Spark
- [Databricks IQ: AI-Driven Analytics for Faster Data Insights | Databricks](https://www.databricks.com/product/data-intelligence-platform): Databricks IQ AI-driven analytics with natural language interface and lakehouse architecture

## Data Management & Governance

- [Lakehouse Storage | Databricks](https://www.databricks.com/product/delta-lake-on-databricks): Delta Lake lakehouse storage with open table formats, Iceberg, and Unity Catalog
- [Unity Catalog | Databricks](https://www.databricks.com/product/unity-catalog): Unity Catalog unified governance for data and AI assets with access control
- [Databricks Delta Sharing - Data Sharing | Databricks](https://www.databricks.com/product/delta-sharing): Delta Sharing cross-platform data sharing and collaboration without proprietary formats

## Data Engineering & Analytics

- [Lakeflow: Unified Data Engineering | Databricks](https://www.databricks.com/product/data-engineering): Lakeflow unified data engineering for ETL pipelines and real-time processing
- [Data Warehousing with Databricks SQL | Databricks](https://www.databricks.com/product/databricks-sql): Databricks SQL serverless warehouse with Photon and Power BI integration

## AI & Machine Learning

- [Production-quality ML and GenAI | Databricks](https://www.databricks.com/product/artificial-intelligence): Mosaic AI for building and deploying GenAI agents and ML applications
- [Databricks AI Research | Databricks](https://www.databricks.com/research/databricks-ai-research): AI research breakthroughs including DBRX model and open-source LLM development

## Customers & Use Cases

- [Customer Stories | Databricks](https://www.databricks.com/customers): Fortune 500 customer case studies and AI adoption stories on Data Intelligence Platform
- [Why Databricks for Executives | Databricks](https://www.databricks.com/why-databricks/executives): Executive-focused value proposition for Data Intelligence Platform and generative AI
- [Transform Your Startup with Databricks: Data & AI at Scale | Databricks](https://www.databricks.com/product/startups): Databricks startup program with $50K credits and go-to-market support
